en: Color souvenir postcard with a golden border showing the Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle surrounded by autumn foliage with the Bucegi Mountains and blue sky in the background. The front caption reads "Castelul Peles." The reverse is a modern divided back titled "SOUVENIR COLLECTION," crediting AGNUS Design s.r.l., and identifies the scene as "SINAIA – Castelul Peleș – The Peles Castle," with a photo credit to Ion Serban (2002) and a code "SN 08 PH."
